features.name: Lexical Java superclass static field reads
features.scope: Unqualified public Java static field reads search the lexical dispatch class superclass chain. Kotlin properties, locals, own companions and JvmField declarations keep precedence; inherited Java fields beat explicit imports and package constants/properties. Java interface constants are excluded from unqualified inheritance, and Kotlin synthetic INSTANCE is hidden. Ordinary function and Java SAM captures are tested. Existing field typing and visibility checks are reused.

validation.clippy: Frozen library, binary and owned test passed with warnings denied.

validation.interop: Fixed Java caller compiled against official output verifies both providers with -Xverify:all; all4 Kotlin provider/consumer pairs and public callable JVM signatures match.
validation.boundaries: Both compilers reject instance-qualified static fields, implicit Java-interface constants, private fields, wrong result types and synthetic Kotlin INSTANCE.

historical_reports_note: Earlier exploration reports and archives remain unchanged. Two runs failed the frozen-input check while semantics/fixtures were expanded; a prior18-pass core report excludes later package-precedence fixtures. Only the final18 cases count here.
limitations: This adds public inherited-static reads through the lexical dispatch class; protected/package fields, inherited-static writes and broader implicit-extension/enclosing-class lookup retain existing bounded support.
Combined branch verification is separate from this exact frozen source. No Android runtime or full-app claim.
